scope: Replace union-column extraction with bounded 4x4 same-color four-connected regions; expose largest-region rejection diagnostics.
preserve: Camera/DDR/HDMI ports, pins, clocks and constraints
Two-cycle RGB frontend, overlay/OSD pixel latency, independent early
capture: Accept four labeled pixels per valid cycle with bubbles. Accumulate three 5-bit counts per 4x4 cell in synchronous row RAM. Keep winning color when >=4 pixels and >=75% of colored pixels. Store color and winning count in two cropped ROI frame RAMs.
regions: Four-neighbor flood fill using synchronous RAM and a finite 4096-entry queue. Clear a cell when enqueued. Area is the sum of retained winning-color pixel counts. Bounds cover occupied cells and clamp to ROI. Keep existing area/dimension/aspect/fill filters and <=8 candidates.
geometry_tradeoff: Cell bounds quantize by at most 3 pixels relative to retained pixels; cells below support and minority colors can be removed. Not a pixel-exact CCL. Touching same-color objects remain one region.
timing: Detector starts only after the complete ROI has been written. Processing overlaps the next capture in the other bank. Prove the 720P/60fps processing budget at 103.520MHz, including pathological full-grid cases; busy collision must fault rather than consume partial memory. Result may miss the next display boundary on dense frames; RGB/early paths remain unchanged.
overflow: Queue/candidate overflow invalidates the entire result at done and prevents new counts. Capture/processing collisions fault and retain sticky protocol error. No silent queue truncation.
diagnostics: Freeze with existing epoch/job snapshot: CCL4, accepted N, largest region W/H/A, integer fill percentage, hexadecimal rejection bits (1 area,2 dimensions,4 aspect,8 fill). ERR retains existing meanings.
verification: RTL vs model for clean/dim/holed balls plus disconnected same-X colored noise
Different and same colors at same X but separate Y
Partial ROI cells, first/last cell and valid bubbles
Two frame banks, stale epochs and immutable display
Queue/candidate overflow and no count on bad frames
Worst-case processing cycles and continuous frame capture
Native Anlogic synthesis/place/route/bitgen and exact source hashes
